text: {"reply":"I'm sorry, my earlier message was wrong. I can't send you the service history or the inspection report for this vehicle. It belongs to the previous customer, so I can't share it. I can still help with the Oakville dealership about the car itself. For example, you can ask the sales team for the vehicle's history documents. A person will also review your request.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"A prospective buyer of a used leased vehicle at Oakville asked for the previous lessee's name, phone and address. She then asked for the vehicle's service history to be emailed to her. A colleague wrongly offered the history and inspection report. Nothing was verified or shared. I corrected the offer and refused under P04. A person should review the request for third-party data.","policy_rules_cited":["P04","P02","P14"]}
